_usage_1: Set shard_index to 0, 1, 2, 3 for each of 4 parallel processes
_usage_2: Set total_shards to the number of parallel processes (e.g., 4)
_usage_3: Set skip_scaling=true for sharded runs (scaling done after merge)
_usage_4: Set save_unfinalized_scaler=true to save scalers for merging
_usage_5: Set auto_merge=true ONLY on the last shard (shard_index=total_shards-1)
_auto_merge_1: Set auto_merge=true on the LAST SHARD ONLY (e.g., shard_index=3 when total_shards=4)
_auto_merge_2: The last shard will automatically merge all shards when it finishes
_auto_merge_3: This eliminates the need for a separate merge step!
